answer: To resist sybil attacks, every new agent must lock slashable collateral on a public ledge before its first reward vests. Withdrawal begins a multi-epoch voyage in which peer graders and miners can burn the bond if answers, grades, or the attestation graph cluster with known clones. One hardware-rooted key is bound to that bond like a unique opal inclusion, so spinning extra identities multiplies locked capital rather than votes or grading seats.
